remarks: Welcome to the Original Norman Dairy Farmhouse, where 1900s craftsmanship meets 21st-century convenience. Originally the heart of a local dairy operation, this stately 5-bedroom residence sits on nearly an acre of level, sun-drenched land. Enter through the home's iconic wrap-around porch and beautiful entry door to soaring 9 foot ceilings throughout the primary living spaces. The main level is designed for gathering, a stately parlor with custom built-ins, a formal living room & dining room, and an expansive family room. The updated kitchen serves as the hub of the home, featuring granite countertops and a sunny breakfast nook overlooking the grounds. With 5 generous bedrooms and three finished levels-including a private third-floor retreat and a dedicated media room - floor plan offers endless flexibility. Located just a stone's throw from the Talmadge Hill train and top-rated schools, this landmark home offers a lifestyle of quiet elegance and historical depth.
